gloss: to contain; to include (a substance or component)

definitions.gloss: to contain; to include; to have as a component
definitions.explanation: For a substance, material, or product to contain a particular element, ingredient, or compound within it. A technical or formal term used mainly in scientific, medical, and product-description contexts.

examples.japanese: この{食品|しょくひん}はカフェインを{含有|がんゆう}する。
アルコールを{含有|がんゆう}する{飲料|いんりょう}。
この{鉱石|こうせき}には{希少|きしょう}な{金属|きんぞく}が{高|たか}い{割合|わりあい}で{含有|がんゆう}されている。
examples.english: This ore contains rare metals in a high proportion.

notes:
A する-verb from {含有|がんゆう}, composed of {含|がん} (to contain, to include) + {有|ゆう} (to have, to possess). More formal and technical than {含|ふく}む.

USAGE:
Primarily used in scientific, pharmaceutical, and regulatory contexts. The noun form {含有|がんゆう} frequently appears in compound words like {含有量|がんゆうりょう} (content, amount contained) and {含有率|がんゆうりつ} (content ratio). In everyday conversation, {含|ふく}む or {入|はい}っている is preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {含有量|がんゆうりょう} — amount contained, content level
- {含有率|がんゆうりつ} — content ratio, percentage
- カフェイン{含有|がんゆう} — caffeine-containing
- アルコール{含有|がんゆう} — alcohol-containing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {含|ふく}む — to contain, to include (everyday word; broader usage)
- {配合|はいごう}する — to blend, to compound (actively mixing ingredients together)
- {入|はい}っている — to be included, to contain (most colloquial option)
